exclusion.reason: typecheck (tsc --noEmit) fails on the repo's own code: missing modules (../types/message.js, postCommitAttribution.js), missing exports from agentSdkTypes.js, wrong config types, and implicit-any/lib target errors; the bun-not-found build failure is secondary and the typecheck failures are not environmental.
